# Extrovert

Extrovert automates LinkedIn prospect engagement through campaigns, monitored topics, writing styles, contexts, and team workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/extrovert/.

## Actions

- **Create Context**: Create a Context for a user.
- **Create Style**: Create a writing Style for a user.
- **Delete Context**: Permanently delete one Context by UUID.
- **Delete Style**: Permanently delete one Style by UUID.
- **Find Prospect by LinkedIn URL** (read-only): Check whether a LinkedIn profile URL already exists among the team's prospects and return every matching prospect.
- **Get Campaign** (read-only): Load full configuration and state for one campaign by its UUID.
- **Get Prospect** (read-only): Load one existing prospect by UUID with LinkedIn profile, campaign and list bindings, flags, connection data, and engagement statistics.
- **Get Workspace Plan Features** (read-only): Return the selected workspace's active plan, API capabilities, feature flags, and quota counters.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): Return all Prospects and Topic campaigns visible to the connected user, including their running state, owner, Context, Style, filters,…
- **List Contexts** (read-only): Return all complete Context records owned by a user.
- **List Prospects** (read-only): Return one page of existing prospects with campaign and list bindings, LinkedIn profile data, flags, connection state, and engagement…
- **List Styles** (read-only): Return all complete writing Styles owned by a user, including learning mode and separate comment and direct-message instructions.
- **List Team Members** (read-only): Return users visible in the selected team, including the user IDs required to list or create owner-scoped contexts and styles.
- **Update Context**: Fully replace a Context's name, company background, and user background.
- **Update Style**: Update a Style's required name and learning-mode setting, optionally replacing or clearing its comment and DM instructions.
